subject: proj
title: PROJ.------COS.P.
description: Diagram in CMBA-12. (C)PROJ (projection) is crossed with COS-P (cosmic particulars): the question is what projection requires of cosmic-particulars in the section that establishes the five degrees of extended functionalism (individual, collective, society, transformation, world-culture-resolidification). PROJ is fed by ACT (activism) and MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). MTA-RT-SIGN also feeds COS-P. COS-P then branches to MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and A-PR (all-purpose) → INFO-ALGN (information alignment). A separate hub: TR (transformation) → INFO-OR (information order) ← DYM-F (dynamic functionalism); INFO-OR then fans to OP-SPD (option spread) and INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). Structural argument: projection is fed by activism *and* meta-reality significance, with meta-reality significance also reaching cosmic particulars in parallel — meaning projection and cosmic particulars share an upstream source. From cosmic particulars, the diagram fans into multiple-diversification and all-purpose → information-alignment, encoding how cosmic-particulars get culturally legible. The transformation/dynamic-functionalism → information-order → option-spread/individual-dynamics chain runs in parallel, registering how transformation produces the option spread Braxton named in CMBA-11 as the structural shape of 1960s alternative routes. The diagram thus diagrams projection's cosmic grounding *and* the parallel transformation→information-order chain that produces the option spread.
